007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015
016/**
017 * Sample for disabling a Select AI profile.
018 *
019 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, obtain a {@link Profile} object for an existing profile, call {@link Profile#disable()}, and print whether the disable operation succeeded.</p>
020 *
021 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
022 * <ul>
023 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
024 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
025 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
026 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
027 * </ul>
028 *
029 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
030 * <pre>{@code
031 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
032 * }</pre>
033 *
034 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
035 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
036 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
037 * <pre>{@code
038 * mvn clean install
039 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
040 * }</pre>
041 *
042 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
043 * <pre>{@code
044 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" -d samples/out samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/DisableProfileSample.java
045 * }</pre>
046 *
047 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
048 * <pre>{@code
049 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.DisableProfileSample
050 * }</pre>
051 *
052 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
053 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
054 * and diagnostics.</p>
055 */
056public final class DisableProfileSample {
057    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DisableProfileSample.class);
058
059    private DisableProfileSample() {
060    }
061
062    public static void main(String[] args) {
063        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
064        try {
065            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
066            Profile profile = selectAI.profile(profileName);
067            boolean disabled = profile.disable();
068
069            System.out.printf("Disable profile '%s' completed: %s%n", profileName, disabled);
070        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
071            LOGGER.error("Failed to disable Select AI profile '{}'.", profileName, e);
072        }
073    }
074
075    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
076        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
077                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
078                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
079                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
080                .build();
081
082        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
083    }
084
085    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
086        String value = System.getenv(name);
087        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
088            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
089        }
090        return value;
091    }
092
093}
